name: face-2-angry
prompt: Generate an image. The reference is my game character, a grumpy cheese crab with a cabbage-leaf shell (Crabbage). Draw THIS SAME character as a cartoon story portrait showing a strong, funny, very readable emotion: furious and fired up: angry scowling eyelids on the eye stalks, gritted teeth in the mouth, leaning forward, a little puff of angry steam above its head. IMPORTANT BODY RULE: Crabbage has exactly TWO big claws (both raised at the sides) and a few short pointed crab legs, exactly like the reference: never extra claws, arms or hands. Its ONLY two eyes sit on top of its two long eye stalks; its round body has NO eyes and NO eyebrows on it, only a mouth. Show the emotion with the mouth, the eyes and eyelids on the stalks, and the two claws held up OPEN and snapping, clearly crab pincers with two jaws each (never fists or fingers). Keep it EXACTLY on-model: same body shape and proportions, same colours, same face design, same thick dark outlines and glossy cel shading as the reference. Do not add any clothes, props, extra limbs or extra characters that are not in the reference. Same three-quarter view and facing direction as the reference, whole body visible, centred, filling about 85% of the frame. Solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadow, no text. Portrait 4:5 image.
